title: The Last Cellar
author: Orsen Sterling
blurb: Ivo Amberdale, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
